name: @builderforce/code-shield
description: THE code-scanning engine shared by the WebContainers Security Shield, the Visualizer, the PR security gate and the skill installer: one rule registry (secrets, insecure code, malicious behaviour, obfuscation, package-manifest heuristics), SHA-256 signatures, risk scoring and SARIF output. Pure TypeScript with no I/O beyond crypto.subtle, so it runs in a Web Worker, the browser and Node. Detectors are registry rows (rule sets, profiles, SignatureSource), so YARA-X/WASM, OSV or taint analysis plug in without changing callers. Source-only: its tests run in the API suite (api/vitest.config.ts collects every source-only package's src).
